==Notes==
*The interrupt effect that is applied as an [[area of effect]] affects all [[action]]s (including basic [[attack]]s) and occurs even if the interrupt on the initial target was [[Interrupt#Interrupt prevention|prevented]].
*Useful for interrupting a clumped group of [[spike]]rs.
*In [[hard mode]], multiple copies of this [[skill]] in the hands of [[foe]]s can decimate an unsuspecting [[party]] in seconds. Especially parties of [[hero]]es and/or [[henchman|henchmen]] are at risk, due to their default formation being very close to one another.
*Damage is done even if interruption is prevented.

==Trivia==
*If target enemy was using a skill, [[creature]]s in the area will scream, ''"#$%#!!"'' in frustration.
